title: Block sites from Google search results
question: How do I block a website from showing up in Google search results?
answer: Google has no setting for blocking a site from your results; its old blocking feature was removed years ago. The usermods script on this page hides every result from the sites on a block list you edit at the top of the script, Pinterest to start with, and leaves the other results in place. Install it with usermods or any userscript manager. Without a script, adding -site:pinterest.com to a search drops that site from that one search.
prompt: Hide Pinterest results from my Google searches.
details:
The block list is the `BLOCKED` array at the top of the script. A domain also covers its subdomains, so `pinterest.com` hides `www.pinterest.com`; country domains such as `pinterest.co.uk` need their own entry. In usermods you can ask the chat to add a site.

Google's result links point to an opaque `/goto` address, so the script reads each result's site from the address line Google prints under its title, or from the video link on video results. It hides the whole result, and a row of videos only when every video in it comes from a blocked site. Images and the AI Overview's source links are not filtered.

alternatives.title: The -site: operator
alternatives.body: Add `-site:pinterest.com` to a search to leave that site out. It only applies to the search you type it into.

alternatives.title: uBlacklist
alternatives.body: The uBlacklist extension keeps a block list in its own settings and adds a block link to each result.

check.baseline: (() => { const host = (el) => { const m = /^https?:\/\/([^\s/›]+)/.exec((el.getAttribute('data-curl') || el.getAttribute('data-surl') || el.textContent).trim()); return m ? m[1].toLowerCase() : ''; }; const pin = [...document.querySelectorAll('#rso cite, #rso [data-curl], #rso [data-surl]')].filter((el) => /(^|\.)pinterest\.com$/.test(host(el))); return pin.some((el) => el.checkVisibility()); })()
check.expect: (() => { const host = (el) => { const m = /^https?:\/\/([^\s/›]+)/.exec((el.getAttribute('data-curl') || el.getAttribute('data-surl') || el.textContent).trim()); return m ? m[1].toLowerCase() : ''; }; const pin = [...document.querySelectorAll('#rso cite, #rso [data-curl], #rso [data-surl]')].filter((el) => /(^|\.)pinterest\.com$/.test(host(el))); return pin.length > 0 && pin.every((el) => !el.checkVisibility()); })()
